projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for listicle-matching focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'listicle-matching' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'listicle-matching'
Add stories US-76-002 through US-76-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-76-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-76-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Seed story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-76-002 through US-76-012) covering listicle detection robustness, chapter confidence calibration, description-enriched embeddings, iterative match chapter-type strategy, cross-chapter coherence diagnostics, mixed numbering normalization, chunking boundary dedup, mid-segment marker detection, bridge confidence graduation, embedding similarity in relevance matrix, and chapter-aware gap query diversity.

userStories.title: Add mid-segment listicle marker detection
acceptanceCriteria: Listicle detector detects markers that appear mid-segment (not just at start of text) with configurable max_chars_offset (default 50)
Mid-segment markers split the segment into two logical groups: text before the marker belongs to the previous group
Detection helper functions (_detect_ordinal, _detect_numbered, _detect_transition) accept an optional scan_full_text parameter
Unit test: marker at character position 30 in a segment is detected when max_chars_offset=50
Unit test: marker at character position 100 is NOT detected when max_chars_offset=50
Unit test: mid-segment detection produces correct group boundaries (previous group ends at marker position)
userStories.notes: Added mid-segment regex patterns (ORDINAL_MID_PATTERN, NUMBERED_MID_PATTERNS, TRANSITION_MID_PATTERNS), scan_full_text param to detection helpers, two-pass scanning in detect_listicle_groups with configurable max_chars_offset (default 50). 6 new tests covering offset detection, boundary correctness, and priority. All 61 tests pass.

userStories.title: Graduate listicle-to-chapter bridge confidence by marker density
acceptanceCriteria: Bridge confidence in listicle_groups_to_chapters is graduated: 0.6 for transition-only markers, 0.7 for ordinal markers, 0.8 for numbered markers, 0.85 when expected_count matches detected count
ListicleGroup dataclass stores a marker_type field ('ordinal', 'numbered', 'transition') set during detection
listicle_groups_to_chapters reads marker_type from each group to compute graduated confidence
Unit test: transition-only groups get confidence 0.6
Unit test: ordinal groups get confidence 0.7, numbered get 0.8
Unit test: groups with matching expected_count get 0.85 regardless of marker type
userStories.notes: Added marker_type field to ListicleGroup dataclass (models.py), set during detect_listicle_groups (listicle_detector.py), graduated confidence in bridge.py: transition=0.6, ordinal=0.7, numbered=0.8, expected_count match=0.85. Added TestGraduatedConfidence class with 6 tests. All 120 tests pass.

userStories.title: Enable and validate description-enriched embeddings
acceptanceCriteria: Config default for description_enriched_embeddings changed from false to true in ContextEnrichmentConfig
config.yaml updated to set description_enriched_embeddings: true
Caption stage _populate_text_metadata appends top 3 description keywords (not full description) to embedding text, prefixed with '[desc:' and suffixed with ']'
Unit test: embedding text includes description keywords when description_enriched_embeddings=true and video has description
Unit test: embedding text unchanged when video has no description (empty string)
Unit test: description keywords are extracted using _extract_topic_keywords (reuse from listicle_detector or equivalent)
userStories.notes: Enabled description_enriched_embeddings by default (config + yaml), changed embedding format to [desc: kw1 kw2 kw3] with top 3 keywords, updated/added tests (12 pass)

userStories.title: Wire chapter-type strategy ranking into iterative match query generation
acceptanceCriteria: IterativeMatchStage._run_iteration uses query_learning.get_strategy_ranking_for_chapter() to order query strategies by chapter type effectiveness
When generating queries for a gap, the stage passes the gap's chapter_type to get_strategy_ranking_for_chapter and uses the returned ranking to prioritize strategies
Fallback to default strategy ordering when chapter_type is 'body' or unknown
Unit test: intro chapter_type gaps use strategy ranking from query learning DB
Unit test: listicle_item chapter_type gaps use strategy ranking from query learning DB
Unit test: body/unknown chapter_type falls back to default strategy ordering
userStories.notes: Tier: integration. Source files: src/stages/iterative_match.py (lines 1935-1976 where chapter_type_by_idx is built but only used for record_result -- need to also use for query generation around line 868+), src/iterative_match/query_learning.py (lines 220-270 get_best_strategy_for_chapter and get_strategy_ranking_for_chapter already exist but are not called from the stage). Test file: tests/test_iterative_match_stage.py or new test.

userStories.title: Add cross-chapter coherence diagnostics logging
acceptanceCriteria: After apply_all_adjustments completes for a full matching pass, a summary log line reports: total chapters detected, avg source consistency score, chapters exceeding coherence_penalty_threshold, and top 3 most-scattered chapters
Diagnostic info is added to the match stage's checkpoint data under a 'chapter_diagnostics' key
Log level is INFO for summary, DEBUG for per-chapter detail
Unit test: diagnostics summary includes correct chapter count and scatter metrics
Unit test: checkpoint data contains chapter_diagnostics dict with expected keys
Unit test: diagnostics gracefully handle zero chapters (no chapter detection)
userStories.notes: Tier: diagnostics. Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (after apply_all_adjustments around line 3400 -- add diagnostic aggregation), src/stages/match.py (where match results are saved to checkpoint -- add chapter_diagnostics). Currently chapter_coherence_penalty fires per-candidate but no aggregated view exists. Test file: tests/test_matching_scoring.py or new test_chapter_diagnostics.py.

userStories.title: Normalize mixed listicle numbering to consistent sequence
acceptanceCriteria: When detect_listicle_groups finds mixed marker types (e.g., 'first', '#2', 'third'), it normalizes group_id to a consistent 0-based sequence regardless of detected label
A new _normalize_marker_sequence function resolves ordinal words to numeric positions and sorts groups by detected position when possible
Mixed numbering where ordinal position can be inferred (e.g., 'first'=1, '#2'=2, 'third'=3) produces groups in correct order
Unit test: 'first', '#2', 'third' produces groups with group_ids 0, 1, 2 in correct order
Unit test: purely transition-based markers preserve original detection order
Unit test: gap in numbering (e.g., '#1', '#3', '#5') preserves relative order without inserting phantom groups
userStories.notes: Tier: robustness. Source files: src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py (lines 276-300 where groups are built -- add normalization pass after group creation, lines 22-29 ORDINAL_WORDS mapping already exists for position lookup). The current code assigns group_id=idx (enumeration index) which works for single-type markers but fails for mixed sequences where a transition marker at position 2 should logically be item #2 based on surrounding ordinals. Test file: tests/test_listicle_detector.py (test_mixed_numbering_styles at line 219 exists but doesn't test normalization).

userStories.title: Deduplicate chapters at chunk overlap boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: merge_chunk_results in chunking.py deduplicates chapters whose segment ranges overlap by more than 50% between adjacent chunks
When two overlapping chapters from adjacent chunks are detected, the one with higher confidence is kept
Deduplication only applies to chapters in the overlap region (defined by overlap_segments parameter)
Unit test: two chunks with 3-segment overlap produce a single chapter (not duplicate) for chapters in the overlap zone
Unit test: chapters outside the overlap zone are preserved from both chunks
Unit test: higher-confidence chapter wins when deduplicating
userStories.notes: Tier: robustness. Source files: src/chapter_detection/chunking.py (lines 142-234 merge_chunk_results -- currently merges by segment index but doesn't explicitly deduplicate overlapping chapters from the overlap zone). The overlap_segments parameter in create_chunks (line 44) defines how many segments overlap between chunks, but merge_chunk_results may produce near-duplicate chapters at boundaries. Test file: new tests/test_chapter_chunking.py or extend existing tests.

userStories.title: Add embedding similarity to cross-chapter relevance matrix
acceptanceCriteria: compute_relevance_matrix accepts an optional embedding_fn parameter that computes cosine similarity between chapter text embeddings
When embedding_fn is provided, relevance score is a weighted blend: 0.6 * Jaccard keyword similarity + 0.4 * embedding cosine similarity
When embedding_fn is None, behavior is unchanged (pure Jaccard, backward compatible)
Unit test: with mock embedding_fn, blended score is correctly weighted
Unit test: without embedding_fn, output is identical to current Jaccard-only behavior
Unit test: embedding similarity of 1.0 with Jaccard 0.0 produces score of 0.4
userStories.notes: Tier: quality improvement. Source files: src/chapter_detection/bridge.py (lines 169-208 compute_relevance_matrix -- currently pure Jaccard). The existing compute_relevance_matrix is called from src/stages/match.py. Adding embedding_fn as optional parameter maintains backward compat. The caller in match.py can pass the project's embedding function if available. Test file: tests/test_chapter_bridge.py (TestComputeRelevanceMatrix class starting around line 401).

userStories.title: Add chapter-aware gap query diversity enforcement
acceptanceCriteria: When generating search queries for gaps within the same chapter, the iterative match stage enforces query diversity: no two gaps in the same chapter use identical query text
A per-chapter query dedup set tracks used queries and triggers query variation (synonym substitution or keyword rotation) when duplicates are detected
Query variation appends chapter-specific context keywords to differentiate otherwise identical queries
Unit test: two gaps in the same chapter with identical voiceover text produce different search queries
Unit test: gaps in different chapters can use identical queries (no cross-chapter dedup)
Unit test: query variation preserves the original query's semantic intent (contains original keywords)
userStories.notes: Tier: quality improvement. Source files: src/stages/iterative_match.py (around line 868 where queries are generated -- add per-chapter dedup tracking), src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py (GapSegment.chapter_id at line 102 provides the chapter grouping key). Currently duplicate queries within a chapter waste search budget by finding the same videos. Test file: tests/test_iterative_match_stage.py or new test.

userStories.title: Add listicle expected-count validation with auto-correction
acceptanceCriteria: When detect_list_header finds expected_count and detected marker count differs by more than 1, the detector attempts auto-correction by lowering marker detection thresholds
Auto-correction re-scans segments with relaxed patterns (e.g., accepting markers beyond first 50 chars, case-insensitive number words)
Auto-correction only runs once (no recursive correction) and logs the before/after marker counts
Unit test: 'top 5 reasons' header with only 3 detected markers triggers re-scan and finds 2 additional markers
Unit test: auto-correction does not increase marker count beyond expected_count + 1
Unit test: auto-correction logs warning when it cannot close the gap between expected and detected
userStories.notes: Tier: robustness. Source files: src/chapter_detection/listicle_detector.py (lines 302-307 where expected_count mismatch is logged -- currently just warns, should trigger re-scan), (lines 223-309 detect_listicle_groups -- add correction pass after initial detection). This improves recall for voiceovers where some list items use non-standard markers that the first pass misses. Test file: tests/test_listicle_detector.py (TestExpectedCount class around line 402).

userStories.title: Add chapter boundary confidence to scoring weight
acceptanceCriteria: ChapterCandidate.confidence is used as a weight multiplier for chapter-based scoring adjustments (chapter_topic_match, chapter_source_consistency, chapter_coherence_penalty)
High-confidence chapters (>0.8) apply full scoring adjustment; low-confidence chapters (<0.5) apply 50% of the adjustment
Linear interpolation between 0.5 and 1.0 multiplier for confidence values between 0.5 and 0.8
Unit test: chapter with confidence 0.9 applies full chapter_topic_match boost
Unit test: chapter with confidence 0.4 applies 50% of chapter_topic_match boost
Unit test: chapter with confidence 0.65 applies ~75% of chapter_topic_match boost (linear interpolation)
userStories.notes: Tier: quality improvement. Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_chapter_topic_match around line 3303+, apply_chapter_source_consistency, apply_chapter_coherence_penalty -- all currently apply flat adjustments regardless of chapter confidence), src/chapter_detection/models.py (ChapterCandidate.confidence at line 44+ is already populated but not propagated to scoring). Need to pass chapter confidence through tiered_matcher.py into scoring functions. Test file: tests/test_chapter_scoring_us75005.py (extend existing tests).
